name: Ebisu ebUSD
oneLiner: ebUSD is Ebisu's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from Liquity-v2 CDP branches backed by weETH, sUSDe, WBTC, LBTC, and stcUSD on Ethereum and Plasma.
collateral: Overcollateralized CDP markets on Ethereum and Plasma using weETH, sUSDe, WBTC, LBTC, and stcUSD; the live adapter reports current per-branch shares, with WETH and XPL configured as additional dormant branches
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with Liquity v2-style user-set interest rates and redemptions; production deployments mint natively on both Ethereum and Plasma

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: ebUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: ebUSD is minted from Liquity-v2-style CDP branches on Ethereum and Plasma when users open troves against weETH, sUSDe, WBTC, LBTC, and stcUSD at user-set interest rates; Ebisu is a licensed friendly fork that modified core (per-branch redemption fees) and is not confirmed-immutable.

controls.label: Ebisu CDP branch contracts (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded per branch by collateral ratio and Liquity-v2-style redemption/liquidation; users set their own interest rate.
controls.evidence: ebUSD is minted via Liquity-v2-style branches with user-set interest rates and redemptions, deployed natively on Ethereum and Plasma.

controls.label: Ebisu protocol admin / governance
controls.evidence: Liquity friendly forks may implement mutability; Ebisu modified core (per-branch redemption fees, Chainlink oracle standard) and administers branch onboarding/parameters, so renouncement is not confirmed and immutable classification is not asserted.

review.evidence: Ebisu is a licensed Liquity-v2 friendly fork minting ebUSD from overcollateralized branches on Ethereum and Plasma; the fork program lets forks add mutability and Ebisu modified core logic, so the admin surface is treated as bounded but present rather than renounced.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Liquity-v2 fork mechanism confirmed; Ebisu's exact admin/upgrade owner, multisig threshold, and immutability status not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve Ebisu's on-chain branch admin/owner and whether ownership is renounced; if renounced, reconsider immutable-user-collateralized.
